'''Di-chrome''' was a material used in camouflage coverings, such as tents and [[DuraShelter/Legends|DuraShelters]]. When inert, di-chrome resembled any regular shelter cloth. When electrically charged however, the di-chrome absorbed ambient light and blended in with its surroundings, making it almost impossible to see with the eye.
